summary: One-line stub that integer-casts the code address WrapperThunk and passes it to BooleanToIntConversion, returning the conversion result unchanged. Return the BooleanToIntConversion result directly; the function performs no other work.

unresolved: Whether the integer-cast function address WrapperThunk is used as a callback handle/registration token or as an opaque pointer value is unknown.
The packet labels WrapperThunk a global, but the raw source reads it as a function address cast to int; whether this is a stored code address or a true function-pointer value is unresolved.
